svg.text: Make 3. Skid: UHMW-PE bar 60 x 20, 450 long; cut a 45 deg nose

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 14 mm deep on the front bottom edge so it rides over crystals.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 11 mm holes 40 and 100 mm from the back of the nose, counter-

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bored 20 mm, 12 deep from below so the bolt heads sit inside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hanger: stainless 6 mm plate 60 wide, bent to an L: upright leg

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright: two slots 11 wide x 24 long, centred 65 and 115 above the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: foot. The slots set the blade 5 to 25 mm above the floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Foot: two 11 mm holes to match the skid.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the upright bolts flat to the beam's back face with the blade

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolts' neighbours; the foot sits on the skid, M10 bolts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Set all three skids to the same height with a 10 mm spacer under

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the blade edge on a flat floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: blade edge 10 mm above the floor along its whole length.
